_doc: D-S4 parity fixture, tranche A slice 1. Asserted by graph-algorithms-parity.spec.ts (browser) AND GraphAlgorithmsParityTest (inspecto-la-graph). The expected values are DERIVED BY HAND from the graph, not produced by either implementation. Labels are lowercase ASCII on purpose: ties break by label, and the browser uses localeCompare while Java uses ordinal compare, which agree only on such labels. Every edge endpoint is a node (the algorithms assume a closed graph). e4 duplicates e1 and e11 is a self-loop, to pin the multigraph rules: degree counts both, the undirected simple-graph algorithms collapse them.

canonicalV1._doc: canonical-v1 (D-4 Decision 3): equal scores rank by UTF-16 code-unit order of the ENTITY ID, then label. Two disjoint edges, so every node has degree 1, core 1, triangles 0 (all tied). Ids by code unit: ACC-0007 < Acc-9 < acc-0042 < acc-1121 (uppercase before lowercase, 'C' 67 < 'c' 99). Labels are chosen so the OTHER orders differ: code-unit order on the label gives Acc-9, acc-1121, acc-0042, ACC-0007 (Alpha < Beta < alpha < zeta); localeCompare on the label gives acc-0042, Acc-9, acc-1121, ACC-0007 (alpha < Alpha < Beta < zeta). Hand-derived.
